versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

product-photo-studio 0.1.9

- Added stronger guidance in the documentation to preserve confirmed product color, accessory, and quantity in all routes.
- Clarified that the hard input is a real product photo and that scene or lighting should not rewrite existing product details.
- Updated references and instructions to emphasize using only the bundled client; no fallback to REST/OpenAPI.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file. 
- General documentation improvements for accuracy and workflow clarity.
Publish the reviewed AI Product Photo Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
